Willoughby Heights continues to outperform many Fraser Valley submarkets due to rapid development, strong community amenities, and sustained buyer interest in larger townhome layouts. Four-bedroom townhomes remain limited in inventory, making them highly desirable for families needing additional space for bedrooms, offices, or multigenerational living.

The area benefits from top-rated schools, expanding commercial hubs, and improved transportation infrastructure along 200 Street and the Trans-Canada Highway. Modern townhome developments increasingly include energy-efficient heating systems, EV-compatible garages, outdoor living spaces, and upgraded interiors — all features that drive buyer engagement and long-term appreciation.
With consistent demand and stable resale performance, Willoughby Heights remains one of Langley’s strongest markets for townhome investment.
